purpose: Composição ilustrativa do banner, sem substituir as fotos dos produtos do cardápio.
prompt: Create a premium photorealistic advertising cutout for a Brazilian pizzeria named Passira. Isolated on a genuinely transparent alpha background, portrait 4:5 composition, one anatomically correct human hand and forearm entering from the bottom and naturally holding up an open pizza takeaway box at chest height, no person or body visible. The box is bold deep red cardboard with a small dark green side panel and subtle white checkerboard detailing on one side, absolutely NO words, letters, logos or watermarks. The lid is open angled behind the food. In the open box, an appetizing large golden pizza with melted mozzarella, tomatoes, white onion rings, olives and herbs, with one slightly lifted slice and a little melted cheese stretch, physically plausible. Three-quarter frontal view looking slightly down into the box so the pizza is fully visible. Product fills most of the upper 70 percent, forearm fills lower 30 percent, all edges of the box visible, no cropping of fingers or pizza. Warm studio food lighting, crisp tactile cardboard, authentic delicious food photography, realistic proportions. Sharp detailed cutout edges. This will be layered as the central hero product on a red website beside giant white typography. No scene, no backdrop, no table, no text. Only food, box, hand and forearm.
